title: 2125 Prairie is built
items: 2125 Prairie, the one wooden house among the brick ones on the east side between 21st and 22nd Streets, now stands as a full house in place of its draft. Its plan comes from the 1911 map: two storeys over a raised basement, a porch across the whole front, a square bay on its north side, an angled bay on its south side and a one-storey range behind. No picture of it is known, so the clapboard, the windows, the steep slate gable facing the avenue and the olive paint with cream trim are a careful best guess, and the house's card says so.
